acceptance.note: A bounce, miss, or zero-casualty result remains that observed result; do not label it successful penetration or KIA

legacy_references.integrity: decoded optional references; no source hash verification

named_effects.contact_mix: low peak-relative authored character; one composite voice with original integrated source energy, support and onset
named_effects.embedded_tail: controls retain recorded tail without another rack; combat character excerpts stay inside existing physical voice
named_effects.gain: existing physical emission/ear calibration, not soundscape cue gain
named_effects.scope: explicit finite named effects; actual gameplay events only

procedural_families: MainGunRecoil, BodyImpact and finite ammunition contacts; continuous loader friction follows actual movement
parametric armor impact, pressure, physical fragment contacts/flight, concussion and enemy caliber report
audio_bank.review: load status and routing only; subjective first-person video review is separate
audio_bank.scope: loaded Audio bank and resolved routes; scene emitters are reported by their scene manifest

small_arms_reports.calibration: existing physical emission and ear calibration; timbres are authored estimates
small_arms_reports.pistol_source_identity: generic owned pistol early crop plus authored pressure, not a verified P08 recording

v1_layers.policy: verified optional layers play only where no feedback replacement is active

metadata.clips: same verified feedback replacements, resolved generated/legacy voices and optional v1 layers as live Audio; see audio_bank
metadata.clock: samples consumed only when the simulation capture advances
metadata.continuous_machinery_controls: engine, running gear, traverse and positioned loops: 5 ms sample-clock gain ramps; 20 ms phase-continuous rate smoothing; retire only after rendered zero; source calibration unchanged
metadata.engine_voice: continuous procedural Maybach; RPM combustion clock, fixed-Hz structure, calibrated group level

listener_ear.stage: per-voice last stage: five-band loudness recruitment, reflex and conductive loss from hearing.rs; world/impact/trauma buses; sample-rate ramps

master.stage: master: battlefield + optional terminal cue -> one lookahead true-peak limiter (-1 dBFS, 200 ms release) -> battlefield-only KIA gate

preparation.backend_buffer_policy: rodio 0.20 default device configuration; host quantum unchanged
preparation.scope: current game thread local MG receiver preparation; not device underrun telemetry

metadata.silence_gate: every sink source is sample-gated, including scene, impact and trauma voices
metadata.sink_controls: ordinary rodio 5 ms source-sample control polling; no wall-clock ramps
metadata.weather_voice: continuous procedural stereo wind, noise-driven seal/hull resonances, sample-rate parameter ramps

audio.source: ordinary runtime gameplay AudioMixer; one simulation clock; embodied Tiger listener shared by both witness tracks

platoon_scope: Three existing T-34-76 actors; installed enemy MLP and TigerPilot station workflow; known contacts disclosed. One singleplayer crewman aboard, one embodied AI controller changing his posts; the other seats are empty.

spatial_proof.measure: per discharge: energy in [+0.05, +1.25] s minus the mean of [-0.55, -0.05] s, per ear (lateral_db = 10 log R/L) and above a 1.5 kHz one-pole high-pass (share of the excess)
spatial_proof.model: acoustics::spatial (Woodworth ITD, Brown-Duda head shadow, presentation pan, plate/hatch transmission of direction cues); levels from sound_propagation unchanged

staging.staging: Real parked T-34; normal rate-limited lay, normal muzzle dispersion, ordinary BR-350B flight/earliest contact/armor/anatomy. Trigger time scripted; no selected damage or terminal injection.
staging.target: requested geometric aim point; not a forced contact
